Day 5 (Mar 18): Return to Little Rock. Transportation: Flight: Flight Number: AA9012, from Austin (AUS) to Little Rock (LIT), Departure 12:00, Arrival 14:30. Breakfast: "Elizabeth Street Café, Austin". Attraction: "-". Lunch: "On the flight or at airport: "Moe's Southwest Grill, Little Rock". Actually lunch after arrival: "Moe's Southwest Grill, Little Rock". Dinner: "-". Accommodation: "-". Since trip ends.
